title: Kodo Rock

[[File:Kodo Rock.jpg|thumb|Kodo Rock]]

'''Kodo Rock'''{{co|54|80|Mulgore}} was a natural monument near [[Camp Narache]] that [[tauren]] [[shaman]] needed to go to for one of their early quests. The rock could only be seen from a short distance so one needed to pay attention.

To get there, one could travel from Camp Narache directly towards the [[Brambleblade Ravine]] and it would be located about halfway along the direct line. A small dirt area would be seen on the minimap to pinpoint it.
